name: Xiaojie! Bie danwu wo shang fen!
source:
This visual novel blends simulation and management gameplay. The protagonist, aiming to become a pro esports player, tries to cut off all distractions but is drawn into a strange adventure with a tsundere childhood friend and a sultry neighbor, where unshakable bonds and passion collide!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3201360]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这部视觉小说融合了模拟和管理游戏玩法。主角立志成为职业电竞选手，试图排除一切干扰，却与傲慢的儿时好友和性感的邻居一起卷入了一场奇怪的冒险，不可动摇的羁绊与激情碰撞！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3201360]Steam[/url]]
